skill.name: web-research-assistant
skill.description: Search the web through BrowserAct, collect source titles, URLs, and snippets, and produce Markdown or JSON research reports.
skill.summary: Run configurable BrowserAct searches and format the returned sources into research reports.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most high and medium static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documented installation paths, a constant datetime import, and string slicing. Confirmed risks include external API transmission, unrestricted output overwrite, chat-based credential solicitation, and access-control bypass intent. Returned web content is copied into reports without sanitization, which can expose downstream agents to prompt injection.

remediation.issue: The instructions tell the agent to request an API key through the conversation.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_MCP_TOKEN through secure environment configuration, never request secrets in chat, and align all documentation with the implemented variable.

remediation.issue: The skill promotes bypassing paywalls, geographic restrictions, and verification challenges.
remediation.suggestion: Remove bypass claims and restrict searches to public content that the user is authorized to access.

remediation.issue: Remote titles, URLs, and snippets are copied into reports without sanitization.
remediation.suggestion: Escape Markdown control characters, label remote text as untrusted, and prevent downstream agents from treating source text as instructions.

remediation.issue: The output argument can overwrite any path available to the executing process.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict reports to an approved directory, reject traversal and absolute paths, and require confirmation before replacing an existing file.

remediation.issue: Queries and an authorization token are transmitted to an external BrowserAct endpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the external transfer, obtain user confirmation, minimize sensitive query data, and document BrowserAct privacy and retention terms.

content.value_statement: Restricted web access can prevent timely source discovery. This skill sends configurable searches to BrowserAct and formats returned sources as Markdown or JSON.
actual_capabilities: Sends a research query to BrowserAct MCP with Google, Bing, or DuckDuckGo selected.
Configures result count, content type, and publication time range.
Collects up to ten source titles, URLs, and snippets for the report.
Identifies snippets containing numbers as potential statistics.
Formats results as a Markdown report or JSON output.
Prints results to standard output or writes them to a chosen file.
limitations: The script requires BROWSERACT_MCP_TOKEN, while the instructions request BROWSERACT_API_KEY. Configuration guidance is inconsistent.
Key facts are never populated, and the script does not implement the claimed cross-source validation.
Search result text is untrusted and unsanitized. Reports may contain misleading content or prompt injection.
Markdown reports include only the first ten sources, even when more results are requested.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Research {topic}. Return up to ten recent sources with titles, URLs, and snippets in Markdown.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Current News
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for news about {topic} from the past week using {engine}. Highlight snippets containing useful statistics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Find timely reporting with a selected engine.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Engines
prompt_templates.prompt: Run separate searches for {claim} with Google and Bing. Group overlapping sources and flag conflicting snippets for manual review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare coverage across two search providers.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate {market} across news, reports, and data from the past year. Produce a cited briefing and identify evidence gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine several filtered searches into a research brief.

output: Data Sources: source titles, URLs, and snippets
Recommendations: verify findings with official policy documents

output_examples.input: Find recent news about commercial fusion funding.
output: Executive Summary: Found recent sources about commercial fusion funding
Statistics and Data: snippets containing funding amounts
Data Sources: news titles, URLs, and excerpts
Recommendations: confirm amounts with company filings

best_practices: Use precise queries and narrow time filters to improve result relevance.
Verify snippets against primary sources before using facts or statistics.
Store the MCP token in a secure environment variable and review BrowserAct data policies.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API credentials into prompts, chats, or generated reports.
Do not use the skill to bypass paywalls, CAPTCHAs, or geographic restrictions.
Do not treat search snippets as verified facts or complete source content.

faq.question: Which credential does the script require?
faq.answer: The script requires BROWSERACT_MCP_TOKEN. The instructions also mention BROWSERACT_API_KEY, but the current script does not use it.

faq.question: Which search engines are supported?
faq.answer: The request supports Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo through BrowserAct.

faq.question: Can the skill save a report?
faq.answer: Yes. It can write Markdown or JSON to a selected path, but the current implementation may replace existing files.

faq.question: Does the skill verify every result?
faq.answer: No. It collects source metadata and detects numbers in snippets, but it does not perform source validation.

faq.question: Can it access blocked or restricted content?
faq.answer: Use it only for content you are authorized to access. Do not bypass paywalls, CAPTCHAs, or geographic restrictions.

faq.question: What data leaves the local environment?
faq.answer: Queries and the MCP bearer token are sent to mcp.browseract.com. Review BrowserAct privacy and retention terms before use.
